sourceNote: Curated snapshot, web-verified as of 2026-09-01. Refresh via check_for_updates.py or the in-app Check for Updates button.

upcoming.notes: Not yet released as of 2026-09-01 (RC/freeze phase); do not offer as a selectable deployment target until GA.

kollaAnsible.notes: Tracks the upstream OpenStack release train.

canonicalCharmedOpenstack.notes: Canonical now steers new small/edge-scale deployments toward Sunbeam (K8s-native, sunbeam cluster bootstrap) instead. Sunbeam is not yet at full outcome parity with classic Charmed OpenStack for large multi-site builds.

ceph.securityNote: 20.2.4 / 19.2.6 (2026-08-19) is an urgent combined security release fixing 4 CVEs, most notably CVE-2025-30156 (AES-CBC/CephX auth-bypass). Introduces a new CephX key type (aes256k) and a specific key-rotation upgrade procedure; multisite RGW needs an rgw_sigv4_insecure toggle during upgrade. Any Ceph-backed deployment on an older point release should patch to this promptly.

neutronSdn.notes: OVN has been the recommended default since the Xena/Yoga era; OVS is legacy.

saudiNca.notes: NCA CSCC (Critical Systems Cybersecurity Controls) is a different, non-cloud-specific framework and should not be used as the label for cloud controls.

dubaiDesc.current: DESC CSP Security Standard, layered on Information Security Regulation (ISR) v3.0

uaeNesa.current: UAE IAR/IAS v2 (Sept 2025), administered by TDRA / Cyber Security Council
uaeNesa.notes: NESA was operationally succeeded by the Signals Intelligence Agency (SIA); 'NESA IAS' remains the common colloquial label industry-wide.

hipaa.status: NPRM proposed, not final as of 2026-08
hipaa.notes: Encryption-at-rest/in-transit and MFA would become mandatory (currently addressable) under the pending HIPAA Security Rule update.

gdpr.notes: Core GDPR text unchanged; EU Data Act Chapter VII (effective 2025-09-12) adds binding cloud data-sovereignty/egress-fee provisions worth citing alongside GDPR for EU data-residency claims.

pure.name: Pure Storage FlashArray
pure.manilaNote: No official Manila driver for FlashArray; Pure's Manila support targets the separate FlashBlade platform.

hpe.name: HPE Alletra / Primera / 3PAR
hpe.manilaNote: No official Manila driver confirmed for this HPE product line.

dellps.name: Dell PowerStore / PowerMax
dellps.manilaNote: No official Manila driver confirmed for PowerStore or PowerMax.

vast.name: VAST Data
vast.notes: Uniquely ships both an official Cinder block driver and Manila file driver from the same VMS management plane.
